title: The Interface That Reports Itself: A Harness Through Which Every QML Failure Is Data a Test Can Read
fallback: This lesson puts together everything this phase says about finding out that QML went wrong, so it needs Qt. Lesson 05-05 builds a fake that records what it was given so that a test can ask, which is the same idea without a QML engine. Without Qt, do that and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a harness that loads QML through the phase, so that a load error, a warning, a failed probe and a missing property are each a failure that a test can count and read
